senses.gloss: m. (חָבַט) pressed down, esp. ḥabut, a legal fiction by which an inclined projection is assumed to be like a horizontal plane.
units: Erub. 9ᵃ או לבוד … או ח׳ אמרינן וכ׳ either we assume the fiction of a junction (v. לָבוּד) or of ḥabut, but both of them we do not assume. [Rashi reads חֲבוֹט or ch. חביט, as imperative: press it down.]
